package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
)

var hist = prometheus.NewHistogram(prometheus.HistogramOpts{
	Name:    "operation_duration_seconds",
	Help:    "Duration of operations",
	Buckets: prometheus.DefBuckets,
})

// scenario for prometheus_observe_without_timer: manual `time.Since(start).Seconds()` + `histogram.Observe(duration)` patterns when `prometheus.NewTimer` would be safer
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.
func HandleRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	start := time.Now()
	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	duration := time.Since(start).Seconds()
	hist.Observe(duration)
	w.Write([]byte("done"))
}

func ProcessData() {
	start := time.Now()
	sum := 0
	for i := 0; i < 1000000; i++ {
		sum += i
	}
	hist.Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())
	_ = sum
}
